rule: Graph-view URL search params must be prefixed (e.g. 'graph-') to avoid colliding with TaskInstance filter params that share the same SearchParamsKeys
trigger: UI component reads or writes SearchParamsKeys (OPERATOR, TASK_STATE, TASK_GROUP, etc.) inside a graph/layout context without a distinguishing prefix
rationale: Graph filters and TaskInstance filters occupy the same URL query-string namespace; unprefixed keys silently override each other

evidence.excerpt: These still conflict with the TaskInstance filters, use keys like 'graph-'

rule: New task-group click interactions in the Grid View must be covered by a Playwright e2e regression test in the dag-grid-view spec
trigger: Component under airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/src/layouts/Details/Grid modifies click/navigation behaviour of task groups without a corresponding Playwright spec update
rationale: Airflow's Playwright grid spec (dag-grid-view.spec.ts) is the authoritative regression harness for Grid View interactions; omitting tests leaves user-facing behaviour unverified

evidence.excerpt: no automated coverage; add a regression test for the new click semantics

rule: Place UI components under the layout folder that exclusively uses them; only put components in 'src/components/' when they are reused across multiple features
trigger: A new component file is added to 'src/components/' but is imported only from a single layout (e.g. layouts/Details/Grid)
rationale: Airflow's UI architecture reserves 'components/' for cross-feature reusable pieces; single-use components in 'components/' inflate the shared namespace and obscure ownership

evidence.excerpt: 'components' are for general reshareable components; move single-use ones to the layout folder

rule: Use an existing query result object (e.g. 'initialConnection') to derive dirty/changed state; do not introduce new useState+useEffect pairs that duplicate already-available data
trigger: A new useState is added to track a form field's initial value when an 'initialXxx' prop or query result already carries that data
rationale: Airflow's UI form patterns rely on a single initialConnection (or equivalent) reference for comparison; extra state variables create a second source of truth and can diverge

evidence.excerpt: We already have initialConnection; compare against conf: extra instead of new useStates

rule: Centralise the Airflow stable-docs base URL in 'src/utils/docs.ts' (or equivalent) and build doc links from that constant; do not hard-code the base URL in multiple component files
trigger: The literal string 'https://airflow.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow/stable' appears in a .tsx/.ts file other than a dedicated docs-URL utility module
rationale: The stable-docs base path is duplicated across components (NothingFoundInfo.tsx, DocsButton.tsx, etc.); centralising prevents divergence if the base path changes

evidence.excerpt: stable docs base URL is hard-coded in multiple places; centralize in src/utils/docs.ts

rule: Use 'total_entries' from the paginated API response for displayed counts, not 'data.items.length' or 'array.length', because the response may represent only one page
trigger: A badge, counter, or summary element is set to 'someData.someArray.length' where someData comes from a paginated Airflow API endpoint
rationale: Airflow's list APIs are paginated; the local array length reflects only the fetched page and silently shows a wrong count to users

evidence.excerpt: API response is paginated; badge count must use total_entries, not alerts.length

rule: Key alert/entity lookup maps by a stable unique identifier (UUID or id), not by a mutable name field that is not enforced to be unique in the Airflow schema
trigger: A Map or dictionary is keyed by 'alert.name', 'deadline.name', or any other Airflow entity name field whose uniqueness is not schema-enforced
rationale: DeadlineAlert.name is not unique in Airflow's data model; keying by it causes the last write to win and silently mis-associates alerts

evidence.excerpt: DeadlineAlert.name is not unique; key by stable identifier (alert UUID) instead

rule: Extract repeated calls to the same Airflow service method (e.g. getDeadlines) across multiple components into a shared custom hook so query keys are identical and React Query cache is reused
trigger: The same generated service hook (e.g. useDeadlinesServiceGetDeadlines) is called with equivalent parameters in two or more sibling components without a shared custom hook
rationale: Duplicate hook calls with divergent query keys defeat React Query's caching and result in redundant network requests against the Airflow API

evidence.excerpt: extract common logic to getDeadlines() hook so query keys match and results are cached

rule: Custom filter hooks (e.g. useTagFilter) must have unit tests covering state transitions such as adding/removing tags and toggling match-mode when tag count crosses relevant thresholds
trigger: A new useXxxFilter hook is added to the UI without a corresponding unit test file
rationale: Airflow's tag filtering logic has edge cases at count boundaries (e.g. < 2 vs >= 2 tags) that are easily regressed; unit tests are required to document and protect this behaviour

evidence.excerpt: add unit tests for add/remove tags, toggling any/all, especially near the 2-tag threshold

rule: Dashboard stats cards that display a non-zero count must link to the corresponding detail/list page consistent with the other stats cards
trigger: A StatsCard component is rendered without an 'href' or 'onClick' prop while other stats cards in the same Dashboard do provide navigation
rationale: Airflow's Dashboard UX convention is that stats cards are navigable; a card that looks clickable but does nothing breaks user expectations set by sibling cards

evidence.excerpt: MissedDeadlines appears clickable but goes nowhere; link to the deadlines page like other stats cards

rule: Never implement client-side filtering or pagination over data already fetched from a paginated Airflow API endpoint; apply all filters through backend query parameters
trigger: A .filter() or .slice() call is applied to an array returned from a paginated Airflow service hook (useXxxServiceGetXxx) to simulate backend filtering or pagination in the UI
rationale: Client-side filtering over a single page silently drops results that are on other pages and creates a mixed source of truth between the backend and the UI

evidence.excerpt: remove partial search until backend is updated; only filter by what the backend can do
client-side filtering breaks pagination; use the backend filter instead

rule: In Airflow's generated OpenAPI client, null and undefined query-parameter values are stripped automatically; do not add explicit '!== null && !== ""' guards before assigning optional query params
trigger: Query parameter passed to a generated service hook is wrapped in a conditional checking for null or empty string before assignment (e.g. 'field: val !== null && val !== "" ? val : undefined')
rationale: Airflow's OpenAPI-generated client omits null/undefined params from the HTTP request; manual guards add noise and can mask bugs by converting empty-string to undefined inconsistently

evidence.excerpt: null and undefined are automatically stripped; owner: userFilter ?? undefined is enough

rule: Components that derive status from async Airflow API queries must guard rendering with isLoading/isError flags; never render a settled status (e.g. 'Met') while queries are still in-flight
trigger: A status indicator, badge, or card renders a definitive state using 'data?.field ?? fallback' without first checking the query's isLoading or isError flag
rationale: Airflow UI components query multiple async endpoints (deadlines, alerts, etc.); rendering from unresolved data produces momentarily incorrect status displays visible to users

evidence.excerpt: renders 'Met' while deadlines still loading; gate on isLoading/isError before showing settled status
loading bar should be matched with isLoading from the query object

rule: Use Chakra UI spacing/size tokens (1, 2, 3, 4, 5 …) for padding, margin, and font-size; do not pass raw pixel values via inline style objects
trigger: A JSX element has a 'style' prop or sx object containing literal pixel strings (e.g. '"padding": "8px"', '"fontSize": "14px"') instead of Chakra token values
rationale: Airflow's UI enforces Chakra UI's design-token system for visual consistency; raw pixel values bypass the token scale and produce inconsistent spacing across the UI

evidence.excerpt: chakraUI provides token values 1,2,3,4,5 for padding/margin for consistency across UI

rule: To clear an optional field through an Airflow PATCH API, send 'null' (not 'undefined'); sending undefined omits the field from JSON and prevents model_fields_set from detecting the clear intent
trigger: A PATCH mutation converts an empty-string form value to 'undefined' before adding the field to updateMask (e.g. 'const field = val === "" ? undefined : val')
rationale: Airflow's backend patch logic uses Pydantic's model_fields_set; fields absent from JSON are not updated, so converting to undefined silently prevents clearing a previously-set value

evidence.excerpt: undefined omitted from JSON payload; updateMask contains field but clear never applies — send null instead

rule: Display API error messages to the user via 'error.message' from the Airflow error object (consistent with usePatchTaskInstance and other existing mutation hooks); do not hand-code per-status-code description strings
trigger: A mutation hook's onError callback maps specific HTTP status codes to hardcoded description strings instead of forwarding 'error.message'
rationale: Airflow's UI convention (established in usePatchTaskInstance and similar hooks) is to surface the backend's own error message; custom strings duplicate maintenance effort and may mislead users

evidence.excerpt: use error.message like usePatchTaskInstance; backend error is shown to user

rule: Every translation key passed to translate() must be registered in the corresponding i18n JSON file (e.g. airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/public/locales/en/components.json) before the PR is merged
trigger: A translate() call uses a new key string that is not present in the en/components.json (or equivalent locale file)
rationale: Airflow's i18n setup requires keys to exist in locale files; missing keys cause the UI to fall back to the default text at best, or render the raw key string at worst

evidence.excerpt: add translation keys to translation files, e.g. en/components.json
